title: Skip Badaling — Hike 7 km of Wild Great Wall, Jiankou to Mutianyu | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone piles onto Badaling. Skip it — and hike about 7 km of wild, unrestored Great Wall from Jiankou to Mutianyu instead.

Badaling is the famous, easy-access section: a direct subway/coach ride from Beijing, and the most crowded stretch of the whole wall. Two hours north sits Jiankou — unrestored, with crumbling watchtowers, steep broken steps, and ramparts half-swallowed by forest. The classic route hikes roughly 7 km of that ruined wall until it meets the restored section at Mutianyu: about three hours on the wall, plus an hour of climbing just to reach it. The payoff: at Mutianyu you can ride a toboggan back down to the gate.

🧭 Expert Tip: hire a local guide for the Jiankou half — it's unmarked, genuinely steep, and some ruined sections are unsafe to scramble solo; end at Mutianyu for the cable car or toboggan down.

别都挤八达岭了——往北两小时，箭扣是没修过的野长城，残楼碎阶、林子吞了半截，徒步约7公里接到慕田峪，走完还能从慕田峪坐滑道下山。
